From 518828fcdfc8c1246fc3ea022e74934d4f6bd76f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Brenda J. Butler" <bjb@mojatatu.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Oct 2017 17:59:22 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] tc-testing: fix arg to ip command: -s -> -n

Fixes: 31c2611b66e0 ("selftests: Introduce a new test case to tc testsuite")
Fixes: 76b903ee198d ("selftests: Introduce tc testsuite")
Signed-off-by: Brenda J. Butler <bjb@mojatatu.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py b/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
index 5f11f5d7456e..a8981c5d0aaf 100755
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py
@@ -152,11 +152,11 @@ def ns_create():
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
         cmd = 'ip link set $DEV0 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
-        cmd = 'ip -s $NS link set $DEV1 up'
+        cmd = 'ip -n $NS link set $DEV1 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
         cmd = 'ip link set $DEV2 netns $NS'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
-        cmd = 'ip -s $NS link set $DEV2 up'
+        cmd = 'ip -n $NS link set $DEV2 up'
         exec_cmd(cmd, False)
 
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `tools/testing/selftests/tc-testing/tdc.py`**
- The command `ip -s $NS link set $DEV1 up` was modified to `ip -n $NS link set $DEV1 up`.
- The command `ip -s $NS link set $DEV2 up` was modified to `ip -n $NS link set $DEV2 up`.

### Relationships
The modifications in `tdc.py` involve changing the argument passed to the `ip` command from `-s` (which stands for "show statistics") to `-n` (which stands for "no statistics"). This change is intended to fix a bug related to the command's functionality in the context of the tc testsuite, as indicated by the fix references in the patch. The changes ensure that the commands executed in the test suite operate correctly without attempting to display statistics that are not needed for the test cases.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by using the `-s` option with the `ip` command, which is intended to show statistics. This option was inappropriate for the context of the test cases in the tc testsuite, leading to incorrect command execution and potential failures in the tests. The correct option to use in this scenario is `-n`, which avoids displaying unnecessary statistics and ensures the commands function as intended within the network namespace.
